artists.biography:
Tears for Fears are an English rock band formed in 1981 by Roland Orzabal and Curt Smith.
Founded after the dissolution of their first band, the mod-influenced Graduate, they were initially associated with the New Wave synthesizer bands of the early 1980s but later branched out into mainstream rock and pop, which led to international chart success.
Their platinum-selling debut album, The Hurting, reached number one on the UK Album Chart, while their second album, Songs from the Big Chair, reached number one on the U.S. Billboard 200, achieving multi-platinum status in both the UK and the United States. Following the release of their third platinum-selling album, The Seeds of Love (1989), Smith and Orzabal parted company in 1991, though Orzabal retained the Tears for Fears name throughout the remainder of the 1990s. The duo re-formed in 2000, and released an album of new material, Everybody Loves a Happy Ending, in 2004. To date, Tears for Fears have sold over 25 million albums worldwide, including more than 8 million in the U.S.

perplexity.description:
Songs For A Nervous Planet by Tears For Fears, released in 2024 on Concord Records, is a hybrid album combining live recordings with four new studio tracks. The live portion captures performances from their Tipping Point Tour Part 2, featuring classic hits such as "Shout," "Everybody Wants to Rule the World," and "Mad World," spanning the band's career from their 1983 debut The Hurting through their 2022 album The Tipping Point. The four new studio songs—"Say Goodbye To Mum And Dad," "The Girl That I Call Home," "Emily Said," and "Astronaut"—add fresh material to the set, blending rock and pop elements consistent with Tears For Fears' signature sound.

This release holds a unique place in Tears For Fears' discography as their first official live album, showcasing their enduring appeal and live performance strength while also continuing their exploration of contemporary themes through new compositions. Coming after The Tipping Point (2022), which marked their return to original material after nearly two decades, Songs For A Nervous Planet serves both as a retrospective and a statement of ongoing creative vitality. While detailed critical and commercial reception data for this 2024 album is not yet widely available, the inclusion of a concert film and a broad international cinema release indicates a significant promotional effort and positive anticipation among fans and critics alike.
